runs.text: Little Roots is an AI-integrated gardening kit and mobile app that helps children aged 5–12 learn plant care through hands-on gardening, plant identification, health monitoring, and interactive growth tracking.

Children often learn about plants through books and screens, with limited hands-on gardening experience. Without timely guidance, they struggle to understand plant needs, maintain care routines, and stay engaged in the process of growing and nurturing plants.

Limited hands-on experience can make it harder for children to understand plant growth, recognize plant needs, and develop consistent care habits. Without engaging guidance, their curiosity about nature and motivation to nurture plants may gradually decline.

Little Roots combines a physical gardening kit with an AI-integrated mobile app, helping children identify plants, monitor plant health, track growth, and learn plant care through interactive activities and hands-on experiences.
